name: Band Single-Arm Row
steps: Stand in a staggered stance facing a waist-high band anchor, grip the band in one hand, and step back until your extended arm holds tension.
Brace your core and keep your chest upright and square to the anchor.
Pull your working elbow smoothly past your ribs until your hand nears your waist, squeezing your back.
Extend your arm slowly back toward the anchor, then switch sides after finishing one arm.
tips: Keep both shoulders square to the anchor instead of twisting open as you pull.
Keep your working shoulder down away from your ear throughout the row.
